description:
Do-won once disguised himself as a stripper to carry out a special mission. When his cover was blown by crime boss Ji-hoon, he suffered a brutal ordeal that left him so traumatized he lived in seclusion for years. After finally pulling himself together and deciding to start anew, Do-won goes for an interview at a new company only to discover that the owner is none other than Ji-hoon. Confronted again with the man who had once destroyed his life, what choice will Do-won make?

*"Were you following me? Why…?"*  
*"Once I set my mind on having something, I never let it go."*

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000051028), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13033182), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/mission_escape)
